name: pos_next
description: POS built on ERPNext that brings together real-time billing, stock management, multi-user access, offline mode, and direct ERP integration. Run your store or restaurant with confidence and control, while staying 100% open source.

scripts.build: if [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pos_next frontend rebuild disabled on production servers (vite OOM-kills 4 GB tenants). Set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to override, or build via GitHub Actions.'; else yarn build:force; fi
